content:
alex_chen: EDR just flagged my laptop for high-rate file writes and a bunch of files renamed to .locked. It quarantined a python3 process. Can someone triage? @mira_k

secops-bot: ALERT INC-2026-0429 - Suspicious file-modification pattern detected on device LPT-0219 (macOS). Action recommended: isolate device, collect forensic image, disable sync.

mira_k: On it. Alex — are you on VPN or external? Please do NOT reboot and don't plug in any external drives. I'll isolate the device via MDM now.

itops: Performing network isolation for device LPT-0219... done. All outbound traffic blocked except mgmt channel.

samir: Can you paste the raw EDR output or a snippet of the alert so we can see the process tree / hashes? Need to know if this is ransomware, crypto-wiper, or a benign script.

alex_chen: Pasting EDR snippet below (redacted paths):

```
{
  "device": "LPT-0219",
  "user": "alex_chen",
  "process": {
    "name": "python3",
    "pid": 8421,
    "cmdline": "python3 /Users/alex/.local/bin/dev-sync --watch",
    "hash": "sha256:abcd1234ef5678...",
  },
  "behavior": {
    "file_ops": "rapid_rename",
    "pattern": "*.docx -> *.locked",
    "count": 412,
    "start_time": "2026-04-29T09:12:03Z"
  }
}
```

mira_k: That pattern looks like a classic encryptor; rapid rename + new extension. Samir, please run yara quickscan and a full signature scan on the disk image once taken.

samir: Running yara set 'ransom_generic, obf_strings' against mounted volume now. Will also check recent pip/pipx installs against known compromised packages.

secops-bot: YARA scan report: 3 matches in /private/var/folders/*/tmp, strings consistent with AES routines; samples uploaded to sandbox: https://sandbox.internal/reports/sha256/abcd1234

carla_legal: Looping legal in — please preserve chain of custody for the image and any sample exfil logs. Also, pause any external customer comms until we know scope. @mira_k @itops

alex_chen: I had 2 AWS profiles configured in ~/.aws/credentials but not actively running any CLI commands. I'll start rotating keys now per runbook.

mira_k: Good. IT, take a read-only disk snapshot forensics ASAP. We need an image before any remediation.

itops: Starting disk image (read-only) now. Target bucket: s3://redwood-forensics/INC-2026-0429/. ETA ~12m. Will apply restricted ACLs and audit logging.

samir: Preliminary triage: the python script was installed via pipx and loaded a dependency 'fast-sync' two days ago. Need to fetch pipx install logs and consult PyPI timestamps. Could be supply-chain compromise.

mira_k: Containment checklist in-flight: 1) device isolated (done). 2) disk image (in progress). 3) credentials rotated (in progress by user). 4) block identified hashes in EDR and on network. 5) reprovision device after forensics.

alex_chen: Stopped Docker/VMs, disabled sync agents, unplugged local drives.

secops-bot: Ticket created: #INC-2026-0429, severity=P1, assignees=mira_k,samir. Timeboxed updates every 30m.

carla_legal: Legal requests copy of any indicators and decision on mandatory disclosure if customer data could be affected. Will standby.

mira_k: @samir @alex_chen who has recent access to the infra repo or credentials that might have been on this device? We need a short list.

samir: I pushed an infra change 3 days ago and used my laptop, not Alex's device, but will audit deploy logs and revoke sessions as precaution.

mira_k: Action items: 1) finish image and hash (itops). 2) yara/full AV scan of image (samir). 3) rotate any AWS/RBAC keys (alex_chen + infra team). 4) legal review (carla_legal). 5) decide reprovision vs targeted cleanup after forensics (mira_k). We'll reconvene after image upload.

itops: Disk image uploaded: s3://redwood-forensics/INC-2026-0429/alex_2026-04-29.img (sha256: abcd1234). Object ACL restricted, bucket logging enabled.

mira_k: Thanks — please share the sandbox report links and any suspicious package names in thread.

samir: Sandbox report: https://sandbox.internal/analysis/abcd1234 - sample shows AES key schedule and file-walk routine. Found 'fast-sync' @1.2.0 referenced in process tree.

alex_chen: Thank you all. I'm available for any questions and will not attempt to restore from backups until instructed.

mira_k: We'll keep this thread as the single source of truth. Next update in 30m or sooner if anything changes.

secops-bot: Incident status: containment=in-progress, forensic-image=complete, escalation=legal-notified.
